text:
Aisha N.: Heads up — FinEdge onboards complaining about 401s + P95 latency ~2s even though they're on Dedicated (eu-west-1). They also reported a sudden billing spike.
Marco L.: Looking at ingress logs now, hang on.
Jordan K.: Quick query shows a bunch of requests for tenant=finedge routed to pool=hosted-global(us-east-1) between 10:12:00-10:14:30 UTC.
Priya S.: Customer repro they sent:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'X-Region: eu-west-1' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
They get `401` intermittently and when successful responses P95 ~ 2s (cross-region RTT + hosted queueing).
Aisha N.: Any recent deploys or config changes to route-service / affinity-service?
Marco L.: route-service rolled at 10:05 UTC in eu-west-1 as part of an autoscaler change. I see a short spike of route-updates at 10:07 where affinity-ttl for some tenants was set to 0 due to a bug in config merge logic.
Jordan K.: Correlating: affinity TTL flush + autoscaler backfill triggered fallback policy -> requests without an active dedicated binding fallthrough to hosted pool in the nearest region configured (us-east-1). That explains latency and billing delta.
Priya S.: Customer billing screenshot attached (they pasted numbers) — we should create credit request. Ticket FIN-3821.
billing-ops: Received. Marked for review, estimating credit after we confirm duration and token count.
Marco L.: Repro locally: run
```bash
# simulate expired affinity
http POST https://route-service.internal/v1/tenants/finedge/affinity ttl:=0
# then send traffic
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -H "X-Region: eu-west-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate & done
```
You can see pool header: `x-serving-pool: hosted-global-us-east-1` in responses.
Aisha N.: Immediate mitigation options?
Jordan K.: Short term: run affinity repair to reprovision the dedicated binding for finedge and warm backfills. Command:
```
/scripts/repair-affinity --tenant finedge --force-rebind
```
That will push traffic back to eu-west-1 dedicated pool.
Marco L.: I'll also push a hotfix to route-service to enforce min-affinity-ttl=30m on merge and add a safety check so TTL never becomes 0 during rolling updates.
Priya S.: Sent customer update with workaround: use dedicated API key + temporary header `X-Force-Pool: dedicated-eu-west-1` while we fix. They accepted and asked for ETA.
Aisha N.: ETA for repair and hotfix?
Marco L.: Repair script run now (10:28 UTC). Hotfix PR opened (route-service#4287). Will canary deploy to eu-west-1 in 15m and promote if green.
deploy-bot: route-service v2.4.1-hotfix canary deploy started in eu-west-1.
Jordan K.: Post-repair telemetry: inbound ratio to dedicated-eu-west-1 jumped from 68% -> 99% for finedge within 2m. Latency returned to normal P95 ~ 120ms.
billing-ops: Confirmed token counts for the affected window, we will propose a partial credit and escalate internal review.
Aisha N.: Follow-ups: 1) postmortem with root cause = config merge bug zeroing TTL during rollout, 2) add alert if >0.5% of tenant traffic crosses-region, 3) add unit test for TTL merge. I'll own the postmortem.
Priya S.: Customer notified, will follow up with the credit confirmation and postmortem when ready. Closing loop with FinEdge.
Marco L.: Thanks team — keeping an eye on route-service metrics for the next 24h.
